name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with combined landholding up to 2 hectares

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
benefit: Timely credit for agriculture and allied activities, including purchase of seeds, fertilizers
eligibility: Individual/Joint borrowers, Tenant farmers, Oral Lessees and Sharecroppers

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: Card with status of soil health and dosage of fertilizers for different crops

name: PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
benefit: Expanding cultivable area under assured irrigation, improve on-farm water use efficiency
